Miscellaneous Criminal Case No.56482 of 2023 is repeat (SECOND) bail application filed by the applicant (Jakir Hussain S/o Mohammad Hussain) under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (herein after referred to as the Code) in connection with Crime No.361 of 2020 registered at Police Station Manak Chowk, Ratlam District Ratlam (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (herein after referred to as the IPC).

entities.text: Police Station Manak Chowk, Ratlam District Ratlam
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant is in jail since 10.09.2023.

His FIRST bail application Miscellaneous Criminal Case No.12599 of 2021 was allowed by this Court vide order dated 19.03.2021.
3.

As per prosecution case, the Branch Manager of Bank of Baroda, Ratlam lodged a written complaint at police station that the present applicant took loan under the Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Guarantee Scheme in the name of his wife for establishment of industry of Dona Pattal making.
The applicant submitted a detailed project report under the aforesaid scheme along with the loan document and a forged quotation issued in the name of Nikki Traders.
The loan documents was processed and an amount Rs.16,23,457/-was sanctioned.

After the release of the aforesaid loan it was found that the accused - applicant did not establish the industry and utilize the aforesaid loan amount in his existing industries and did not repay the loan to the bank.
Accordingly, FIR was registered against the accused persons including Smt. Ehteshaam daughter of accused - applicant.

4. First bail application of the accused - applicant was allowed by this Court on an undertaking given by the accused - applicant that he would deposit Rs.10,00,000/- (rupees ten lakhs) in Bank of Baroda.
He deposited Rs.5,00,000/- (rupees five lakhs) before his release, but failed to deposit Rs.5,00,000/- (rupees five lakhs) after release within a period of three months.

Therefore, Bank of Baroda filed Miscellaneous Criminal Case No.48300 of 2023 an application under Section 439 (2) of the Code seeking cancellation of bail order dated 19.03.2021 passed by this Court in Miscellaneous Criminal C a s e No.12599 of 2021, whereby respondent No.1 (Jakir Hussain S/o Mohammad Hussain) granted regular bail in connection with Crime No.361 of 2020 registered at Police Station Manak Chowk, Ratlam, District Ratlam (M.P.) for the alleged offence.

sentences.text: 6. Bank of Baroda has filed an application for cancellation of bail, because the accused - respondent No.1 (Jakir Hussain S/o Mohammad Hussain) did not deposit Rs.5,00,000/- (rupees five lakhs) and is not cooperating in the trial.
7. So far as the application filed by Bank of Baroda for cancellation of bail is concerned, the same has rendered infructuous, as accused - respondent No.1 is in custody.
Accordingly, Miscellaneous Criminal Case No.48300 of 2023 is dismissed, as it has rendered infructuous.

8. So far as repeat bail application of accused - applicant (Jakir Hussain S/o Mohammad Hussain) is concerned, in view of the undertaking given by the learned counsel for the applicant, the bail application filed by the applicant is allowed with the condition that before release the applicant shall deposit Rs.2,50,000/- (rupees two lakhs fifty thousand) and thereafter, Rs.2,50,000/- (rupees two lakhs fifty thousand) within a period of two months from the date of his release.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) of the Code.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial, however, in case of bail jump, it shall become ineffective.
9. It is made clear that if the applicant (Jakir Hussain S/o Mohammad Hussain) fails to deposit the aforesaid amount, then he will surrender before the trial Court.
10. Accordingly, Miscellaneous Criminal Case No.56482 of 2023 stands allowed and disposed off.
